propositions: The generator recognises only a closed set of os.environ access patterns (get, subscript, os.getenv, KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS); any other key-bearing form like pop or setdefault is silently skipped, causing environment variables to vanish from docs/env-vars.md without warning.

Changing os.environ.get(KEY) to os.environ.pop(KEY, None) still reads the variable but the generator no longer registers it, so the key disappears from the registry and no diagnostic (exit code, stderr, or generator output) signals the loss.
The local make lint gate does not catch stale or incomplete registry — only the full test suite runs the drift check, creating a false local signal that masks broken documentation.
An unrecognised os.environ access pattern must fail the build rather than silently omit keys, so novel accessor forms (e.g., os.environ.take_it) abort instead of shipping undocumented.
